datasets.summary: Re-downloaded both author edgeR tables (hashes match manifest) and compared the derived 72h-minus-Fed effect with the registered Explorer output: Pearson 0.99983, Spearman 0.99970, direction 0.97188 over 15,009 strict-symbol pairs. Not valid for author-concordance-v2: the reference combines two separately fitted pairwise analyses (shared 24h libraries carry different per-library normalization constants), and registered-output coverage is 0.774 (0.787 with the recorded Ensembl join), below 0.90 because 4,390 registered genes are outside the author filter.

verificationReview.reason: GEO deposits only adjacent Fed-versus-24h and 24h-versus-72h edgeR tables from separate pairwise fits; the same 24-hour libraries carry different per-library normalization constants (0.99630, 1.01554, 0.99946) and each table has its own filtered universe. The derived 72h-minus-Fed effect agrees closely with the registered output (Pearson 0.99983, 15,009 strict-symbol pairs) but is reconstructed evidence, and 4,390 registered genes lie outside the author filter (registered coverage 0.774). Author P/FDR for the exact contrast is unavailable.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain a direct author Fed-versus-72h table or joint-model output; keep author concordance not assessed until then. Do not restrict the scope to author-filtered genes to meet coverage.

metrics.basis: Registered Explorer output versus project-derived -(author Fed-24h)+(author 72h-24h); strict unique author symbols

datasets.summary: Retrieved the paper supplements (Europe PMC bundle; PMC bin links returned an HTML challenge). Tables S2-S6 are P/padj<0.1 selected lists with linear fold change only; none gives the registered WT-only HFD-versus-CD effect. S6 (HFD vs CD pooled across Gpr101 genotypes, 327 genes) agrees strongly with the registered output as non-equivalent context (320 pairs, Pearson 0.978, 100% same direction), but its cohort includes KO animals and its estimand is genotype-pooled, so no v2 comparison is valid.

verificationReview.reason: The paper supplements (mmc2.xlsx Tables S2-S6) give only P/padj<0.1 selected genes with linear fold changes for KO-versus-WT, within-diet KO-versus-WT, interaction and genotype-pooled HFD-versus-CD effects. No table gives the registered WT-only HFD-versus-CD effect; the genotype-pooled Table S6 includes Gpr101 KO animals. Its close agreement with the registered output (320 pairs, Pearson 0.978) is non-equivalent context, not author concordance.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain the authors' WT-only HFD-versus-CD result or model object; do not relabel the genotype-pooled Table S6 as an author-result match.

metrics.basis: NON-EQUIVALENT CONTEXT: registered WT HFD-vs-CD limma logFC versus author Table S6 genotype-pooled HFD-vs-CD signed linear FC (log2-transformed), unique author symbols

datasets.summary: Retrieved all publisher supplementary datasets (PMC returned an HTML challenge; Europe PMC reports not open access). Dataset EV1/EV2 are liver DEX-by-hypoxia gene tables and EV3 is figure-level two-way ANOVA; the hypothalamic 313-upregulated-gene result exists only as text, heatmap and motif analysis. No hypothalamic gene-level author table exists, so no v2 comparison is possible.

verificationReview.reason: The publisher supplements contain liver-only gene tables (Dataset EV1/EV2: DEX-responsive genes gained under 6 h and 24 h hypoxia), figure-level two-way ANOVA results (Dataset EV3) and a Figure EV1A source-data PDF. The hypothalamic result is reported only as 313 upregulated genes (LFC>0.3, P<0.05) in text and a heatmap, with no machine-readable gene identifiers, effects or statistics.
verificationReview.nextStep: Request the 313-gene hypothalamic DE table with identifiers, effects and P values from the authors; liver tables cannot substitute.

datasets.summary: Re-read the PMC full text and supplementary inventory (one PDF; no gene-level spreadsheet). The only author DEG table described (169 up/101 down, DESeq2 FDR<0.05) is for HFD ARC, while the registered track is normal chow; normal-chow results are a figure-level clock-gene panel (Supplemental Figure 4A) far below 30 genes. No v2 comparison is valid.
